source_meta._title: Woodland mansion structure '1x1_b3' has dark oak leaf block with persistent tag set to 'false'

stor.recommended_version: Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1, because it is an affected release listed in the report and supports the report-provided /place template command for deterministic placement.
stor.environment: A new single-player Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1 world in Creative mode with commands enabled. A Superflat world is recommended as a practical choice so the isolated mansion room is easy to place, enter, and inspect without unrelated terrain obstructing it.
preconditions: Use an unmodified Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1 client.
Create a new single-player world in Creative mode; ensure commands are enabled.
Prefer the Superflat world type, or otherwise move to a clear area where the woodland mansion room template will be visible and accessible.
Use the default controls unless they have been rebound: T opens chat, F3 toggles the debug screen, Space ascends during Creative flight, and Left Shift descends.
Do not deliberately wait after placing the structure; proceed to inspect the target leaf as soon as the room has rendered.

steps.action: Start the Minecraft Launcher, select the unmodified Java Edition 1.20.1 installation, and launch the game.
steps.success_cue: The Minecraft title screen is open and identifies the running version as Java Edition 1.20.1.

steps.action: Create a new single-player world in Creative mode. Enable commands if the world-creation screen exposes a separate command or cheats option. For easier inspection, select the Superflat world type before creating the world.
steps.exact_input: Singleplayer -> Create New World -> Game Mode: Creative; optionally select World Type: Superflat -> Create New World
steps.success_cue: The player has spawned in a Creative-mode world and can fly by double-tapping Space.

steps.action: Wait for initial world loading to finish before placing the template.
steps.success_cue: Nearby terrain is rendered, player movement responds normally, and no loading screen is present.

steps.action: Move to a clear location with enough visibility to inspect a single woodland mansion room. If using Creative flight, double-tap Space to begin flying and use W/A/S/D, Space, and Left Shift to position the player.
steps.exact_input: Double-tap Space; then use W/A/S/D, Space, and Left Shift as needed.
steps.success_cue: The player is stationary in a clear area with rendered terrain and no nearby obstruction that would prevent entering or viewing the placed room.

steps.action: Open the in-game chat field. The command must be run by the player in chat, with the leading slash included.
steps.success_cue: The chat input field is open and ready to accept a command.

steps.action: Enter the report-provided command exactly and execute it by pressing Enter. This places the woodland mansion template named 1x1_b3 at the command execution position.
steps.success_cue: The command is accepted and the 1x1_b3 woodland mansion room appears at or near the player instead of an unknown-command or permission error being shown.

steps.action: Allow the placed room and its surrounding chunks to finish rendering, then proceed directly to inspection without unnecessary waiting.
steps.success_cue: The placed room is fully visible, movement responds normally, and its blocks are no longer appearing progressively due to chunk rendering.

steps.action: Toggle on the Java debug screen. If the keyboard maps function keys to hardware controls, use the keyboard's Fn modifier together with F3.
steps.exact_input: F3 (or Fn+F3 on keyboards that require it)
steps.success_cue: Debug information is visible on the screen, including a Targeted Block section when the crosshair points at a block.

steps.action: Enter or move around the placed 1x1_b3 room and locate the small decorative tree referenced by the report. Use Creative flight for access if necessary. Identify the dark oak leaf block forming the foliage of that small tree; do not target an unrelated wall, wood, or decorative block.
steps.exact_input: Use W/A/S/D to move, Space to ascend, Left Shift to descend, and the mouse to look around.
steps.success_cue: The small decorative tree inside the placed 1x1_b3 room is visible, and its dark oak leaf block can be reached with the crosshair.

steps.action: Move close enough to the small tree for block targeting, then center the crosshair directly on its dark oak leaf block while keeping the F3 debug screen enabled.
steps.exact_input: Move the mouse until the crosshair rests on the target dark oak leaf block.
steps.success_cue: The F3 Targeted Block section identifies the crosshair target as minecraft:dark_oak_leaves and displays that block's state properties, including the persistent property.

stor.handoff_condition: The 1x1_b3 woodland mansion template has been placed, the F3 debug screen is enabled, and the crosshair has just been centered on the small decorative tree's minecraft:dark_oak_leaves block so its block-state properties are visible. Hand control to the observation subsystem now.
uncertainties: The report does not specify a seed, coordinates, or world type. A new Superflat Creative world is a practical deterministic environment, not a report requirement.
The report does not explicitly prescribe a game mode. Creative mode and commands are selected so the supplied /place command can be executed and the isolated room can be navigated easily.

The report identifies the target as the leaf block on the small tree but does not provide coordinates within the template. The executor must locate that decorative feature visually and confirm the target through the F3 Targeted Block identifier.

The original description contains the older structure-block method, while a later confirmation supplies the simpler /place template command for affected versions beginning with 1.19.1. This plan uses the exact later command in affected version 1.20.1.
No external web verification was needed because the report itself supplies the affected version, exact template identifier, exact /place command, debug-screen action, and target block.
